question: Under what condition of scriptural understanding should one drink the boon-giving vāruṇī?
premises: The meaning of Veda and śāstra can be determined.
Drinking is prescribed for one who has determined scriptural meaning.
inference: Only one who has properly ascertained the meaning of Veda and śāstra is fit to drink the boon-giving vāruṇī.
uncertainties: The scope of vedaśāstra is broad and not specified further here.
plain_english: One who has determined the meaning of the Vedas and śāstras should drink the boon-giving vāruṇī.
